description.value: Twain [tweɪn], Mark, actually Samuel Langhorne Clemens [ˈklemənz], American writer, * 30.11.1835 in Florida (Missouri), † 21.4.1910 in Redding (Connecticut). Mark Twain became best known for his books about the adventures of Tom Sawyer and Huckleberry Finn, in which he humorously illuminates American society.
